aadhiyandu vaakyamundenu, vaakyamu dhevuniyoddha undenu, vaakyamu dhevudai yundenu.
aayana aadhi yandu dhevuniyoddha undenu. Samasthamunu aayana moolamugaa kaligenu,
kaligiyunnadhediyu aayana lekunda kalugaledu.
aayanalo jeevamundenu; aa jeevamu manushyulaku velugaiyundenu.
aa velugu chikatilo prakaashinchuchunnadhi gaani chikati daani grahimpakundenu.
dhevuniyoddhanundi pampabadina yoka manushyudu undenu; athani peru yohaanu.
athani moolamugaa andaru vishvasinchunatlu athadu aa velugunugoorchi saakshya michutaku saakshigaa vacchenu.
athadu aa velugaiyunda ledu gaani aa velugunugoorchi saakshyamichutaku athadu vacchenu.
nijamaina velugu undenu; adhi lokamuloniki vachuchu prathi manushyuni veliginchuchunnadhi.
aayana lokamulo undenu, loka maayana moolamugaa kaligenu gaani lokamaayananu telisikonaledu.
aayana thana svakee yulayoddhaku vacchenu; aayana svakeeyulu aayananu angeekarimpaledu.
thannu endharangeekarinchiro vaarikanda riki, anagaa thana naamamunandu vishvaasamunchinavaariki, dhevuni pillalagutaku aayana adhikaaramu anugrahinchenu.
vaaru dhevunivalana puttinavaare gaani, rakthamuvalananainanu shareerecchavalananainanu maanushecchavalananainanu puttinavaaru kaaru.
aa vaakyamu shareeradhaariyai, krupaasatyasampoornu dugaa manamadhya nivasinchenu; thandrivalana kaligina advi theeyakumaaruni mahimavale manamu aayana mahimanu kanugontimi
yohaanu aayananugoorchi saakshya michuchu naa venuka vachuvaadu naakante pramukhudu ganuka aayana naakante mundativaadaayenaniyu, nenu cheppinavaadu eeyane aniyu elugetthi cheppenu.
aayana paripoornathalonundi manamandharamu krupa vembadi krupanu pondithivi.
dharmashaastramu moshedvaaraa anu grahimpabadenu; krupayu satyamunu yesu kreesthudvaaraa kaligenu.
evadunu eppudainanu dhevuni choodaledu; thandri rommunanunna advitheeya kumaarude aayananu bayalu parachenu.
neevevadavani adugutaku yoodulu yerooshalemu nundi yaajakulanu leveeyulanu yohaanunoddhaku pampinappudu athadichina saakshyamidhe.
athadu erugananaka oppukonenu; kreesthunu kaanani oppukonenu.
kaagaa vaaru mari neevevaravu, neevu eleeyaavaa ani adugagaa athadu kaananenu.
neevu aa pravakthavaa ani adugagaakaanani uttharamicchenu. Kaabatti vaaruneevevaravu? Mammu pampinavaariki memu uttharamiyyavalenu ganuka ninnugoorchi neevemi cheppukonuchunnaavani athani nadigiri
andu kathadu pravakthayaina yeshayaa cheppinattu nenu prabhuvu trova saraalamucheyudi ani aranyamulo elugetthi cheppu okani shabdamu ani cheppenu.
pampabadinavaaru parisayyulaku chendina vaaru
vaaru neevu kreesthuvainanu eleeyaavainanu aa pravaktha vainanu kaaniyedala enduku baapthismamichuchunnaavani athanini adugagaa
yohaanu nenu neellalo baapthismamichuchunnaanu gaani naa venuka vachuchunnavaadu mee madhya unnaadu;
meeraayana nerugaru, aayana cheppula vaarunu vipputakainanu nenu yogyudanu kaanani vaarithoo cheppenu.
yohaanu baapthismamichuchunna yordaanunadhiki aavalanunna bethaniyalo ee sangathulu jarigenu.
maruvaadu yohaanu yesu thanayoddhaku raagaa chuchi idigo lokapaapamunu mosikonipovu dhevuni gorrepilla.
naa venuka oka manushyudu vachuchunnaadu; aayana naakante pramukhudu ganuka naakante mundati vaadaayenani nenevarinigoorchi cheppithino aayane yeeyana.
nenu aayananu eruganaithini gaani aayana ishraayeluku pratyakshamagutaku nenu neellalo baapthisma michuchu vachithinani cheppenu.
mariyu yohaanu saakshyamichuchu aatma paavuramuvale aakaashamunundi digivachuta chuchithini; aa aatma aayanameeda nilichenu.

nenu aayananu eruganaithini gaani neellalo baapthisma michutaku nannu pampinavaadu neevevanimeeda aatma digivachi niluchuta choothuvo aayane parishuddhaatmalo baapthisma michuvaadani naathoo cheppenu.
eeyane dhevuni kumaarudani nenu telisikoni saakshyamichi thinanenu.
marunaadu marala yohaanunu athani shishyulalo iddarunu niluchundagaa
athadu naduchuchunna yesu vaipu chuchi idigo dhevuni gorrapilla ani cheppenu.
athadu cheppina maata aa yiddaru shishyulu vini yesunu vembadinchiri.
yesu venukaku thirigi, vaaru thannu vembadinchuta chuchi meeremi vedakuchunnaarani vaarinadugagaa vaarurabbee, neevu ekkada kaapuramunnaavani aayananu adigiri. Rabbiyanu maataku bodhakudani arthamu.
vachi choodudani aayana vaarithoo cheppagaa vaaru velli, aayana kaapuramunna sthalamu chuchi, aa dinamu aayana yoddha basachesiri. Appudu pagalu ramaarami naalugu gantala vela aayenu.
yohaanu maata vini aayananu vembadinchina yiddarilo okadu seemonu pethuruyokka sahodarudaina andreya.
ithadu modata thana sahodarudaina seemonunu chuchimemu messeeyanu kanugonti mani athanithoo cheppi

yesunoddhaku athani thoodukoni vacchenu. Messeeya anu maataku abhishikthudani arthamu. Yesu athanivaipu chuchineevu yohaanu kumaarudavaina seemonuvu; neevu kephaa anabaduduvani cheppenu. Kephaa anu maataku raayi ani arthamu.
marunaadu aayana galilayaku vellagori philippunu kanugoni nannu vembadinchumani athanithoo cheppenu.
philippu betsayidaavaadu,anagaa andreya pethuru anuvaari pattanapu kaapurasthudu.
philippu nathanayelunu kanugoni dharmashaastramulo mosheyu pravakthalunu evarini goorchi vraasiro aayananu kanugontimi; aayana yosepu kumaarudaina najareyudagu yesu ani athanithoo cheppenu.
anduku nathanayelunaja rethulonundi manchidhedaina raagaladaa ani athani nadugagaa vachi choodumani philippu athanithoo anenu.
yesu nathanayelu thana yoddhaku vachuta chuchi idigo yithadu nijamugaa ishraayeleeyudu, ithaniyandu e kapatamunu ledani athanigoorchi cheppenu.
nannu neevu elaagu erugudu vani nathanayelu aayananu adugagaa yesu philippu ninnu piluvakamunupe, neevu aa anjoorapu chettu krinda unna ppude ninnu chuchithinani athanithoo cheppenu.
nathana yelubodhakudaa, neevu dhevuni kumaarudavu, ishraayelu raajavu ani aayanaku uttharamicchenu.
anduku yesu aa anjoorapu chettukrinda ninnu chuchithinani nenu cheppinanduvalana neevu nammuchunnaavaa? Veetikante goppa kaaryamulu choothuvani athanithoo cheppenu.
mariyu aayana meeru aakaashamu teravabadutayu, dhevuni doothalu manushyakumaarunipaigaa ekkutayunu diguta yunu choothurani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppu chunnaananenu.
moodava dinamuna galilayaloni kaanaa anu oorilo oka vivaahamu jarigenu.
yesu thalli akkada undenu; yesunu aayana shishyulunu aa vivaahamunaku piluva badiri.
draakshaarasamai poyinappudu yesu thallivaariki draakshaarasamu ledani aayanathoo cheppagaa
yesu aamethoo ammaa, naathoo neekemi (pani)? Naa samaya minkanu raaledanenu.
aayana thalli parichaarakulanu chuchi aayana meethoo cheppunadhi cheyudanenu.
yoodula shuddheekaranaachaara prakaaramu rendesi moodesi thoomulu pattu aaru raathibaanalu akkada unchabadiyundenu.
yesu-aa baanalu neellathoo nimpudani vaarithoo cheppagaa vaaru vaatini anchulamattuku nimpiri.
appudaayana vaarithoo meerippudu munchi, vindu pradhaaniyoddhaku theesikonipondani cheppagaa, vaaru theesikonipoyiri.

aa draakshaarasamu ekkada nundi vaccheno aa neellu munchi theesikonipoyina parichaarakulake telisinadhigaani vindu pradhaaniki teliyaka poyenu ganuka draakshaarasamaina aa neellu ruchichuchinappudu aa vindu pradhaani pendli kumaaruni pilichi
prathivaadunu modata manchi draakshaarasamunu posi, janulu matthugaa unnappudu jabburasamu poyunu; neevaithe idivarakunu manchi draakshaarasamu unchukoni yunnaavani athanithoo cheppenu.
galilayaloni kaanaalo, yesu ee modati soochakakriyanu chesi thana mahimanu bayaluparachenu; anduvalana aayana shishyulu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchiri.
atutharuvaatha aayanayu aayana thalliyu aayana sahodarulunu aayana shishyulunu kapernahoomunaku velli akkada konni dinamulundiri.
yoodula paskaapanduga sameepimpagaa yesu yerooshalemunaku velli
dhevaalayamulo edlanu gorrelanu paavuramulanu ammuvaarunu rookalu maarchuvaarunu koorchunduta chuchi
traallathoo koradaaluchesi, gorrelanu edlanannitini dhevaalayamulonundi thoolivesi, rookalu maarchuvaari rookalu challivesi, vaari ballalu pada drosi
paavuramulu ammu vaarithoo veetini ikkada nundi theesikonipondi; naa thandri yillu vyaapaaraputillugaa cheyakudani cheppenu.
aayana shishyulu nee yintinigoorchina aasakthi nannu bhakshinchunani vraaya badiyunnattu gnaapakamu chesikoniri.
kaabatti yoodulu neevu ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaave; ye soochaka kriyanu maaku choopedavani aayananu adugagaa
yesu ee dhevaalayamunu padagottudi, moodu dinamulalo daani lepudunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
yoodulu ee dhevaalayamu naluvadhiyaaru samvatsaramulu kattire; neevu moodu dinamulalo daanini lepuduvaa aniri.
ayithe aayana thana shareeramanu dhevaalayamunugoorchi yee maata cheppenu.
aayana mruthulalonundi lechina tharuvaatha aayana ee maata cheppenani aayana shishyulu gnaapakamu chesikoni, lekhanamunu yesu cheppina maatanu nammiri.
aayana paskaa (panduga) samayamuna yerooshalemulo undagaa, aa pandugalo anekulu aayana chesina soochakakriyalanu chuchi aayana naamamandu vishvaasamunchiri.
ayithe yesu andarini eriginavaadu ganuka aayana thannu vaari vashamu chesikona ledu. aayana manushyuni aantharyamunu erigina vaadu
ganuka evadunu manushyunigoorchi aayanaku saakshyamiyya nakkaraledu.
yoodula adhikaariyaina neekodhemanu parisayyu dokadundenu.

athadu raatriyandu aayanayoddhaku vachi bodhakudaa, neevu dhevuniyoddhanundi vachina bodha kudavani me merugudumu; dhevudathaniki thoodaiyuntene gaani neevu cheyuchunna soochakakriyalanu evadunu cheyaledani aayanatho cheppenu.
anduku yesu athanithoo'okadu krotthagaa janminchithene kaani athadu dhevuni raajyamunu choodaledani neethoo nishchayamugaa cheppu chunnaananenu.
anduku neekodhemu musali vaadaina manushyudelaagu janmimpagaladu? Rendavamaaru thalli garbamandu praveshinchi janmimpagaladaa ani aayananu adugagaa
yesu itlanenu okadu neetimoolamugaanu aatmamoolamu gaanu janminchithenegaani dhevuni raajyamulo praveshimpa ledani neethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
shareera moolamugaa janminchinadhi shareeramunu aatmamoolamugaa janminchinadhi aatmayunai yunnadhi.
meeru krotthagaa janmimpavalenani nenu neethoo cheppinanduku aashcharyapadavaddu.
gaali thana kishtamaina chootanu visarunu; neevu daani shabdamu vinduvegaani adhi yekkadanundi vachuno yekkadiki povuno neeku teliyadu. aatmamoolamugaa janminchina prathivaadunu aalaage yunnaadanenu.
anduku neekodhemu ee sangathulelaagu saadhyamulani aayananu adugagaa
yesu itlanenu neevu ishraayeluku bodhakudavai yundi veetini erugavaa?
memu erigina sangathiye cheppuchunnaamu, chuchinadaanike saakshyamichuchunnaamu, maa saakshyamu meerangeekarimparani neethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
bhoosambandhamaina sangathulu nenu meethoo cheppithe meeru nammakunnappudu, paralokasambandha mainavi meethoo cheppinayedala elaagu nammuduru?
mariyu paralokamunundi digivachinavaade, anagaa paralokamulo undu manushyakumaarude thappa paralokamu naku ekkipoyina vaadevadunu ledu.
aranyamulo moshe sarpamunu elaagu etteno,
aalaage vishvasinchu prathivaadunu nashimpaka aayana dvaaraa nityajeevamu pondunatlu manushyakumaarudu etthabadavalenu.
dhevudu lokamunu enthoo preminchenu. Kaagaa aayana thana advitheeyakumaarunigaa puttina vaaniyandu vishvaasamunchu prathivaadunu nashimpaka nityajeevamu pondunatlu aayananu anugrahinchenu.
lokamu thana kumaaruni dvaaraa rakshana pondutakegaani lokamunaku theerpu theerchutaku dhevudaayananu lokamuloniki pampa ledu.
aayanayandu vishvaasamunchuvaaniki theerpu theerchabadadu; vishvasimpanivaadu dhevuni advitheeyakumaaruni naamamandu vishvaasa munchaledu ganuka vaaniki inthaku munupe theerpu theerchabadenu.
aa theerpu idhe; velugu lokamuloniki vacchenu gaani thama kriyalu cheddavainanduna manushyulu velugunu premimpaka chikatine preminchiri.
dushkaaryamu cheyu prathivaadu velugunu dveshinchunu, thana kriyalu dush‌kriyalugaa kanabadakundunatlu velugunoddhaku raadu.
satyavarthanudaithe thana kriyalu dhevuni moolamugaa cheyabadiyunnavani pratyakshaparacha badunatlu velugunoddhaku vachunu.
atu tharuvaatha yesu thana shishyulathoo kooda yoodaya dheshamunaku vachi akkada vaarithoo kaalamu gadupuchu baapthismamichuchu undenu.
saleemu daggara nunna ainonanu sthalamuna neellu visthaaramugaa undenu ganuka yohaanu kooda akkada baapthismamichuchu undenu; janulu vachi baapthismamupondiri.
yohaanu inkanu cherasaalalo veyabadiyunda ledu.
shuddheekaranaachaaramunu goorchi yohaanu shishyulaku oka yoodunithoo vivaadamu puttenu.

ganuka vaaru yohaanu noddhaku vachibodhakudaa, yevadu yordaanuku avathala neethoo kooda undeno, nee vevanigoorchi saakshyamichithivo, yidigo, aayana baapthisma michuchunnaadu; andaru aayanayoddhaku vachu chunnaarani athanithoo cheppiri.
anduku yohaanu itlanenu thanaku paralokamunundi anugrahimpabadithenegaani yevadunu emiyu ponda neradu.
nenu kreesthunu kaananiyu, aayanakante mundhugaa pampabadinavaadane aniyu cheppinattu meere naaku saakshulu.

pendlikumaarthegalavaadu pendli kumaarudu; ayithe niluvabadi pendli kumaaruni svaramu vinedi snehithudu aa pendli kumaaruni svaramu vini mikkili santhooshinchunu; ee naa santhooshamu paripoornamai yunnadhi.
aayana hecchavalasiyunnadhi, nenu thaggavalasi yunnadhi.
painundi vachuvaadu andariki painunnavaadu; bhoomi nundi vachuvaadu bhoosambandhiyai bhoosambandhamaina sangathulanugoorchi maatalaadunu; paralokamunundi vachu vaadu andariki paigaanundi
thaanu kannavaatinigoorchiyu vinnavaatinigoorchiyu saakshyamichunu; aayana saakshyamu evadunu angeekarimpadu.
aayana saakshyamu angeekarinchinavaadu dhevudu satyavanthudanu maataku mudravesi yunnaadu.
yelayanagaa dhevudu thaanu pampinavaaniki kolathalekunda aatmananugrahinchunu ganuka aayana dhevuni maatale palukunu.
thandri kumaaruni preminchuchunnaadu. Ganuka aayana chethiki samasthamu appaginchi yunnaadu.
kumaaruniyandu vishvaasamunchuvaade nityajeevamugalavaadu, kumaaruniki vidheyudu kaanivaadu jeevamu choodadu gaani dhevuni ugratha vaanimeeda nilichi yundunu.
yohaanu kante yesu ekkuvamandhini shishyulanugaa chesikoni vaariki baapthismamichuchunna sangathi parisayyulu vinirani prabhuvunaku telisinappadu
aayana yoodaya dheshamu vidichi galilayadheshamunaku thirigi vellenu.
ayinanu yese baapthismamiyyaledu gaani aayana shishyulichu chundiri.
aayana samaraya maargamuna vellavalasivacchenu ganuka
yaakobu thana kumaarudaina yosepukichina bhoomi daggaranunna samarayaloni sukhaaranu oka ooriki vacchenu.
akkada yaakobu baavi yundenu ganuka yesu prayaanamuvalana alasiyunna reethine aa baavi yoddha koorchundenu; appatiki inchuminchu pandrendu gantalaayenu.
samaraya stree okate neellu chedukonu taku akkadiki raagaa yesunaaku daahamunakimmani aame nadigenu.
aayana shishyulu aahaaramu konutaku ooriloniki velliyundiri.
aa samaraya streeyooduda vaina neevu samaraya streenaina nannu daahamunakimmani yelaagu aduguchunnaavani aayanathoo cheppenu. ela yanagaa yoodulu samarayulathoo saangatyamu cheyaru.
anduku yesu neevu dhevuni varamunu naaku daahamunakimmani ninnu aduguchunnavaadevado adhiyu erigiyunte neevu aayananu aduguduvu, aayana neeku jeevajala michunani aamethoo cheppenu.
appudaa stree ayyaa, yee baavi lothainadhi, chedukonutaku neekemiyu ledhe; aa jeevajalamu elaagu neeku dorakunu?
thaanunu thana kumaallunu, pashuvulunu, yeebaavineellu traagi maakichina mana thandriyaina yaakobukante neevu goppavaadavaa? Ani aayananu adigenu.
anduku yesu ee neellu traagu prathivaadunu marala dappigonunu;
nenichu neellu traagu vaadeppudunu dappigonadu; nenu vaanikichu neellu nityajeevamunakai vaanilo ooredi neeti buggagaa undunani aamethoo cheppenu.
aa stree aayananu chuchi ayyaa,nenu dappigonakundunatlunu, chedukonuta kinthadooramu raakundunatlunu aa neellu naaku dayacheyumani adugagaa
yesu neevu velli nee penimitini piluchukoni yikkadiki rammani aamethoo cheppenu.
aa streenaaku penimiti ledanagaa, yesu aameto naaku penimiti ledani neevu cheppina maatasariye;
neeku ayiduguru penimitlundiri, ippudu unnavaadu nee penimiti kaadu; satyame cheppithivanenu.
appudaa stree ayyaa, neevu pravakthavani grahinchuchunnaanu.
maa pitharulu ee parvathamandu aaraadhinchiri gaani aaraa dhimpavalasina sthalamu yerooshalemulo unnadani meeru cheppudurani aayanathoo anagaa yesu aamethoo itlanenu
ammaa, oka kaalamu vachuchunnadhi, aa kaalamandu ee parvathamu meedhanainanu yerooshalemulonainanu meeru thandrini aaraadhimparu. Naa maata nammumu;
meeru meeku teliyani daanini aaraadhinchuvaaru, memu maaku telisinadaanini aaraadhinchuvaaramu; rakshana yoodulalo nundiye kaluguchunnadhi.

ayithe yathaarthamugaa aaraadhinchuvaaru aatmathoonu satyamuthoonu thandrini aaraadhinchu kaalamu vachuchunnadhi; adhi ippudunu vaccheyunnadhi; thannu aaraadhinchuvaaru attivaare kaavalenani thandri koruchunnaadu.
dhevudu aatma ganuka aayananu aaraadhinchu vaaru aatmathoonu satyamuthoonu aaraadhimpavalenanenu.
aa stree aayanathoo kreesthanabadina messeeya vachunani nenerugudunu; aayana vachinappudu maaku samasthamunu teliyajeyunani cheppagaa
yesu neethoo maatalaadu chunna nene aayananani aamethoo cheppenu.
inthalo aayana shishyulu vachi aayana streethoo maatalaaduta chuchi aashcharyapadiri gaanineekemi kaavale naniyainanu, eemethoo enduku maatalaadu chunnaavani yainanu evadunu adugaledu.
aa stree thana kunda vidichipetti ooriloniki velli
meeru vachi, nenu chesina vanniyu naathoo cheppina manushyuni choodudi; eeyana kreesthukaadaa ani aa oorivaarithoo cheppagaa
vaaru oorilonundi bayaludheri aayanayoddhaku vachuchundiri.
aa logaa shishyulubodhakudaa, bhojanamu cheyumani aayananu vedukoniri.
andukaayana bhujinchutaku meeku teliyani aahaaramu naaku unnadani vaarithoo cheppagaa
shishyulu aayana bhujinchutaku evadaina nemainanu tecchenemo ani yokanithoo okadu cheppu koniri.
yesu vaarini chuchinannu pampinavaani chitthamu neraverchutayu, aayana pani thudamuttinchutayu naaku aahaaramai yunnadhi.
inka naalugu nelalaina tharuvaatha kothakaalamu vachunani meeru cheppuduru gadaa. Idigo mee kannuletthi polamulanu choodudi; avi ippude tellabaari kothaku vachiyunnavani meethoo cheppu chunnaanu.
vitthuvaadunu koyuvaadunu kooda santhoo shinchunatlu, koyuvaadu jeethamu puchukoni nitya jeevaartha maina phalamu samakoorchukonuchunnaadu.
vitthuvaa dokadu koyuvaadokadanu maata yee vishayamulo satyame.
meeru dheninigoorchi kashtapada ledo daanini koyutaku mimmunu pampithini; itharulu kashtapadiri meeru vaari kashtaphalamulo praveshinchuchunnaarani cheppenu.
nenu chesinavanniyu naathoo cheppenani saakshya michina streeyokka maatanubatti aa ooriloni samarayulalo anekulu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchiri.
aa samarayulu aayanayoddhaku vachi,thamayoddha undumani aayananu vedukoniri ganuka aayana akkada rendu dinamulundenu.
aayana maatalu vininanduna inkanu anekulu nammi aa streeni chuchi'ikameedata neevu cheppina maatanubatti kaaka
maamattuku memu vini, yeeyana nijamugaa lokarakshakudani telisikoni nammuchunnaamaniri.
aa rendudinamulaina tharuvaatha aayana akkadanundi bayaludheri galilayaku vellenu.
endukanagaa pravaktha svadheshamulo ghanatha pondadani yesu saakshya micchenu.
galilayulukooda aa pandugaku velluvaaru ganuka yerooshalemulo panduga samayamuna aayanachesina kaaryamulanniyu vaaru chuchinanduna aayana galilayaku vachinappudu vaaru aayananu cherchukoniri.
thaanu neellu draakshaarasamugaa chesina galilayaloni kaanaaku aayana thirigi vacchenu. Appudu kaperna hoomulo oka pradhaanikumaarudu rogiyaiyundenu.
yesu yoodayanundi galilayaku vacchenani athadu vini aayanayoddhaku velli, thana kumaarudu chaava siddhamaiyundenu ganuka aayanavachi athani svastha parachavalenani vedukonenu.
yesusoochaka kriyalanu mahatkaaryamulanu chooda kunte meerenthamaatramu nammarani athanithoo cheppenu.
andukaa pradhaani prabhuvaa, naa kumaarudu chaavaka munupe rammani aayananu vedukonenu.
yesu neevu vellumu, nee kumaarudu bradhikiyunnaadani athanithoo cheppagaa aa manushyudu yesu thanathoo cheppina maata nammi velli poyenu.
athadinka velluchundagaa athani daasulu athaniki edurugaavachi, athani kumaarudu bradhiki yunnaadani teliyajeppiri.
e gantaku vaadu baagu padasaagenani vaarini adiginappudu vaaruninna onti gantaku jvaramu vaanini vidichenani athanithoo cheppiri.
nee kumaarudu bradhikiyunnaadani yesu thanathoo cheppina ganta adhe ani thandri telisikonenu ganuka athadunu athani yintivaarandarunu nammiri.
idi yesu yoodaya nundi galilayaku vachi chesina rendava soochakakriya.
atutharuvaatha yoodula panduga yokati vacchenu ganuka yesu yerooshalemunaku vellenu.
yerooshalemulo gorrela dvaaramu daggara, hebree bhaashalo betesda anabadina yoka koneru kaladu, daaniki ayidu mantapamulu kalavu.
aa yaa samayamulaku dhevadootha konetilo digi neellu kadalinchuta kaladu. neeru kadalimpabadina pimmata, modata evadu diguno vaadu etti vyaadhigalavaadainanu baagu padunu,
ganuka aa mantapamulalo rogulu, gruddivaaru, kuntivaaru oochakaaluchethulu galavaaru, gumpulugaa padiyundiri.
akkada muppadhi yenimidi endlanundi vyaadhigala yoka manushyudundenu.
yesu, vaadu padiyunduta chuchi, vaadappatiki bahukaalamunundi aa sthithilonunnaadani yerigi svasthapada goruchunnaavaa ani vaani nadugagaa
aa rogi ayyaa, neellu kadalimpabadinappudu nannu konetiloniki dinchutaku naaku evadunu ledu ganuka nenu vachunanthalo mariyokadu naakante mundhugaa digunani aayanaku uttharamicchenu.
yesu neevu lechi nee parupetthikoni naduvumani vaanithoo cheppagaa
ventane vaadu svasthathanondi thana parupetthikoni nadichenu.
aa dinamu vishraanthidinamu ganuka yoodulu idi vishraanthidinamu gadaa; neevu nee parupetthikona thagadhe ani svasthatha nondinavaanithoo cheppiri.
anduku vaadu nannu svasthaparachinavaadu nee parupetthikoni naduvumani naathoo cheppenanenu.
vaaru nee parupetthikoni naduvumani neethoo cheppinavaadevadani vaanini adigiri.
aayana evado svasthathanondinavaaniki teliyaledu; aa chootanu gumpu koodiyundenu ganuka yesu thappinchukonipoyenu.
atutharuvaatha yesu dhevaalayamulo vaanini chuchi'idigo svasthathanondithivi; mari yekkuva keedu neeku kalugakundunatlu ikanu paapamu cheyakumani cheppagaa
vaadu velli, thannu svasthaparachinavaadu yesu ani yoodulaku teliyajeppenu.
ee kaaryamulanu vishraanthi dinamuna chesinanduna yoodulu yesunu himsinchiri.
ayithe yesunaathandri yidi varaku panicheyuchunnaadu, nenunu cheyuchunnaanani vaariki uttharamicchenu.

aayana vishraanthi dinaachaaramu meeruta maatramegaaka, dhevudu thana sontha thandri ani cheppi, thannu dhevunithoo samaanunigaa chesikonenu ganuka indu nimitthamunu yoodulu aayananu champavalenani mari ekkuvagaa prayatnamu chesiri.
kaabatti yesu vaariki itlu pratyuttharamicchenu thandri yedi cheyuta kumaarudu choochuno, adhe kaani thananthata thaanu ediyu cheyaneradu; aayana vetini cheyuno, vaatine kumaarudunu aalaage cheyunu.

thandri, kumaaruni preminchuchu, thaanu cheyuvaati nellanu aayanaku agaparachuchunnaadani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu. Mariyu meeru aashcharya padunatlu veetikante goppa kaaryamulanu aayanaku agaparachunu.
thandri mruthulanu elaagu lepi bradhikinchuno aalaage kumaarudunu thanakishtamu vachinavaarini bradhikinchunu.
thandri yevanikini theerpu theerchadu gaani

thandrini ghanaparachunatlugaa andarunu kumaaruni ghanaparacha valenani theerputheerchutaku sarvaadhikaaramu kumaaruniki appaginchiyunnaadu; kumaaruni ghanaparachanivaadu aayananu pampina thandrini ghanaparachadu.
naa maata vini nannu pampinavaaniyandu vishvaasamunchuvaadu nitya jeevamu galavaadu; vaadu theerpuloniki raaka maranamulo nundi jeevamuloniki daatiyunnaadani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
mruthulu dhevuni kumaaruni shabdamu vinu gadiya vachuchunnadhi, ippude vachiyunnadhi, daanini vinuvaaru jeevinthurani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
thandri yelaagu thananthata thaane jeevamugalavaadai yunnaado aalaage kumaarudunu thananthata thaane jeevamugalavaadai yundutaku kumaaruniki adhikaaramu anugrahinchenu.
mariyu aayana manushya kumaarudu ganuka theerputheerchutaku (thandri) adhikaaramu anugrahinchenu.
deeniki aashcharyapadakudi; oka kaalamu vachuchunnadhi; aa kaalamuna samaadhulalo nunnavaarandaru aayana shabdamu vini
melu chesinavaaru jeeva punarut'thaanamunakunu keedu chesinavaaru theerpu punarut'thaanamunakunu bayatiki vacchedaru.

naa anthata nene emiyu cheyalenu; nenu vinu natlugaa theerpu theerchuchunnaanu. Nannu pampina vaani chitthaprakaarame cheyagorudunu gaani naa yishta prakaaramu cheyagoranu ganuka naa theerpu nyaayamainadhi.
nannu goorchi nenu saakshyamu cheppukoninayedala naa saakshyamu satyamu kaadu.
nannugoorchi saakshya michu verokadu kaladu; aayana nannugoorchi ichu saakshyamu satyamani yerugudunu.
meeru yohaanu noddhaku (kondarini) pampithiri; athadu satyamunaku saakshyamicchenu.
nenu manushyulavalana saakshyamangeekarimpanu gaani meeru rakshimpa badavalenani yee maatalu cheppuchunnaanu.
athadu manduchu prakaashinchuchunna deepamaiyundenu, meerathani velugulo undi konthakaalamu aanandichutaku ishta padithiri.

ayithe yohaanu saakshyamukante naa kekkuvaina saakshyamu kaladu; adhemanina, nenu nera verchutakai thandri ye kriyalanu naa kichiyunnaado, nenu cheyuchunna aa kriyale thandri nannu pampi yunnaadani nannugoorchi saakshyamichuchunnavi.
mariyu nannu pampina thandriye nannugoorchi saakshya michuchunnaadu; meeru e kaalamandainanu aayana svaramu vinaledu; aayana svaroopamu choodaledu.
aayana evarini pampeno aayananu meeru nammaledu ganuka meelo aayana vaakyamu nilichiyundaledu.
lekhana mulayandu meeku nityajeevamu kaladani thalanchuchu vaatini parishodhinchuchunnaaru, ave nannugoorchi saakshyamichu chunnavi.
ayithe meeku jeevamu kalugunatlu meeru naayoddhaku raanollaru.
nenu manushyulavalana mahima ponduvaadanukaanu.
nenu mimmunu erugudunu; dhevuni prema meelo ledu.
nenu naa thandri naamamuna vachiyunnaanu, meeru nannu angeekarimparu, mari yokadu thana naamamuna vachinayedala vaanini angee karinthuru,
advitheeya dhevunivalana vachu meppunukoraka yokanivalana okadu meppuponduchunna meeru elaagu nammagalaru? Nenu thandriyoddha meemeeda neramu mopudunani thalanchakudi;
meeraashrayinchuchunna moshe meemeeda neramu mopunu.
athadu nannugoorchi vraasenu ganuka meeru moshenu namminattayina nannunu nammuduru.
meerathani lekhanamulanu nammaniyedala naa maatalu elaagu nammuduranenu.
atutharuvaatha yesu thiberiya samudramu, anagaa galilaya samudramu daati addariki vellenu.
rogula yedala aayana chesina soochaka kriyalanu chuchi bahu janulu aayananu vembadinchiri.
yesu kondayekki akkada thana shishyulathoo kooda koorchundenu.
appudu paskaa anu yoodula panduga sameepinchenu.
kaabatti yesu kannuletthi bahu janulu thanayoddhaku vachuta chuchiveeru bhujinchutaku ekkadanundi rottelu koni teppinthumani philippu nadigenu gaani
yemi cheyanai yundeno thaane yerigi yundi athanini pareekshinchutaku aalaagadigenu.
anduku philippuvaarilo prathivaadunu konchemu konchemu puchukonutakainanu renduvandala dhenaaramula rottelu chaalavani aayanathoo cheppenu.
aayana shishyulalo okadu, anagaa seemonu pethuru sahodarudaina andreya
ikkada unna yoka chinna vaaniyoddha ayidu yavala rottelu rendu chinna chepalu unnavi gaani, yintha mandiki ivi emaatramani aayanathoo anagaa
yesu janulanu koorchundabettudani cheppenu. aa choota chaala pachikayundenu ganuka lekkaku inchuminchu ayiduvelamandi purushulu koorchundiri.
yesu aa rottelu pattukoni kruthagna thaasthuthulu chellinchi koorchunnavaariki vaddinchenu. aalaaguna chepalukooda vaarikishtamainantha mattuku vaddinchenu;
vaaru trupthigaa thinina tharuvaatha emiyu nashtapadakunda migilina mukkalu pogucheyudani thana shishyulathoo cheppenu.
kaabatti vaaru bhujinchina tharuvaatha vaari yoddha migilina ayidu yavala rottela mukkalu poguchesi pandrendu gampalu nimpiri.
aa manushyulu yesu chesina soochaka kriyanu chuchinijamugaa ee lokamunaku raabovu pravaktha eeyane ani cheppukoniri.
raajugaa cheyutaku vaaru vachi thannu balavanthamugaa pattukonabovuchunnaarani yesu erigi, marala kondaku ontarigaa vellenu.
saayankaalamainappudu aayana shishyulu samudramu noddhaku velli done yekki samudrapu taddarinunna kapernahoomunaku povuchundiri.
anthalo chika taayenu gaani yesu vaariyoddhaku inkanu raaledu.
appudu pedda gaali visaragaa samudramu ponguchundenu.
vaaru inchuminchu rendu kosula dooramu donenu nadipinchina tharuvaatha, yesu samudramumeeda naduchuchu thama donedaggaraku vachuta chuchi bhayapadiri;
ayithe aayana nene, bhayapadakudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
kanuka aayananu donemeeda ekkinchukonutaku vaarishtapadiri. Ventane aa done vaaru velluchunna pradheshamunaku cherenu.

marunaadu samudraputaddarini nilichiyunna jana samoohamu vachi choodagaa, oka chinna done thappa akkada mariyokati ledaniyu, yesu thana shishyulathoo kooda done ekkaledu gaani aayana shishyulu maatrame velliraniyu telisikoniri.
ayithe prabhuvu kruthagnathaa sthuthulu chellinchinappudu vaaru rotte bhujinchina chootu naku daggaranunna thiberiyanundi vere chinna donelu vacchenu.
kaabatti yesunu aayana shishyulunu akkada lekapovuta janasamoohamu chuchi nappudu vaaraa chinna donelekki yesunu vedakuchu kapernahoomunaku vachiri.
samudraputaddarini aayananu kanugoni bodhakudaa, neeveppudu ikkadiki vachithivani adugagaa
yesu meeru soochanalanu choochutavalana kaadu gaani rottelu bhujinchi trupthi pondutavalanane nannu vedakuchunnaarani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.

kshayamaina aahaaramukoraku kashtapadakudi gaani nityajeevamu kaluga jeyu akshayamaina aahaaramukorake kashtapadudi; manushya kumaarudu daanini meekichunu, indukai thandriyaina dhevudu aayanaku mudravesiyunnaadani cheppenu.
vaaru memu dhevuni kriyalu jariginchutaku emi cheya valenani aayananu adugagaa
yesu aayana pampina vaaniyandu meeru vishvaasamunchutaye dhevuni kriyayani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru atlayithe memu chuchi ninnu vishvasinchutaku neevu e soochaka kriya cheyuchunnaavu? emi jariginchuchunnaavu?
bhujinchu taku paralokamunundi aayana aahaaramu vaariki anu grahinchenu ani vraayabadinattu mana pitharulu aranyamulo mannaanu bhujinchirani aayanathoo cheppiri.
kaabatti yesu paralokamunundi vachu aahaaramu moshe meekiyyaledu, naa thandriye paralokamunundi vachu nijamaina aahaaramu meekanu grahinchuchunnaadu.
paralokamunundi digi vachi, lokamunaku jeevamu nichunadhi dhevudanugrahinchu aahaaramai yunnadani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo cheppenu.
kaavuna vaaru prabhuvaa,yee aahaaramu ellappudunu maaku anugrahinchu maniri.
anduku yesu vaarithoo itlanenu jeevaahaaramu nene; naayoddhaku vachuvaadu emaatramunu aakaligonadu,
naayandu vishvaasamunchu vaadu eppudunu dappigonadu.
meeru nannu chuchi yundiyu vishvasimpaka yunnaarani meethoo cheppithini.
thandri naaku anugrahinchu vaarandarunu naayoddhaku vatthuru; naayoddhaku vachuvaanini nenentha maatramunu bayatiki trosiveyanu.
naa yishtamunu neraverchu konutaku nenu raaledu; nannu pampina vaani chitthamu neraverchutake paralokamunundi digi vachithini.
aayana naaku anugrahinchina daani yanthatilo nene miyu pogottukonaka, antyadhinamuna daani leputaye nannu pampinavaani chitthamaiyunnadhi.
kumaaruni chuchi aayanayandu vishvaasamunchu prathivaadunu nityajeevamu pondutaye naa thandri chitthamu; antyadhinamuna nenu vaanini lepudunu.
kaabatti nenu paralokamunundi digi vachina aahaaramani aayana cheppinanduna yoodulu aayananugoorchi sanugukonuchu eeyana yosepu kumaarudaina yesu kaadaa?
eeyana thalidandrulanu mana merugudumu gadaa? Nenu paralokamunundi digi vachi yunnaanani eeyana elaagu cheppuchunnaadaniri.
anduku yesumeelo meeru sanugukonakudi;
nannu pampina thandri vaanini aakarshinchithene gaani yevadunu naa yoddhaku raaledu; antyadhinamuna nenu vaanini lepudunu.
vaarandarunu dhevunichetha bodhimpabaduduru ani pravakthala lekhanamulalo vraayabadiyunnadhi ganuka thandrivalana vini nerchukonina prathivaadunu naayoddhaku vachunu.
dhevuni yoddhanundi vachinavaadu thappa mari yevadunu thandrini chuchiyundaledu; eeyane thandrini chuchi yunna vaadu.
vishvasinchuvaade nityajeevamu galavaadu. jeevaahaaramu nene.
mee pitharulu aranyamulo mannaanu thininanu chanipoyiri.
deenini thinuvaadu chaava kundunatlu paralokamunundi digivachina aahaara midhe.

paralokamunundi digi vachina jeevaahaaramunu nene. Evadainanu ee aahaaramu bhujinchithe vaadellappudunu jeevinchunu; mariyu nenichu aahaaramu lokamunaku jeevamukorakaina naa shareerame ani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
yoodulu'eeyana thana shareeramunu elaagu thina niyyagaladani yokanithoo okadu vaadhinchiri.
kaavuna yesu itlanenumeeru manushyakumaaruni shareeramu thini aayana rakthamu traagithene kaani, meelo meeru jeevamu galavaaru kaaru.
naa shareeramu thini naa rakthamu traaguvaade nityajeevamu galavaadu; antyadhinamuna nenu vaanini lepudunu.
naa shareeramu nijamaina aahaaramunu naa rakthamu nijamaina paanamunai yunnadhi.
naa shareeramu thini naa rakthamu traaguvaadu naayandunu nenu vaaniyandunu nilichiyundumu.
jeevamugala thandri nannu pampenu ganuka nenu thandri moolamugaa jeevinchuchunnatte nannu thinuvaadunu naa moolamugaa jeevinchunu.
idhe para lokamunundi digivachina aahaaramu; pitharulu mannaanu thiniyu chanipoyinattu gaadu; ee aahaaramu thinuvaadu ellappudunu jeevinchunani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppu chunnaananenu
aayana kapernahoomulo bodhinchuchu samaajamandiramulo ee maatalu cheppenu.
aayana shishyulalo anekulu ee maata vini yidi kathinamaina maata, yidi evadu vinagaladani cheppukoniri.
yesu thana shishyulu deeninigoorchi sanugukonuchunnaarani thanakuthaane yerigi vaarithoo itlanenu deenivalana meeru abhyantharapaduchunnaaraa?
aalaagaithe manushyakumaarudu munupunna chootunaku ekkuta meeru chuchinayedala emanduru?
aatmaye jeevimpacheyuchunnadhi; shareeramu kevalamu nish‌prayojanamu. Nenu meethoo cheppiyunna maatalu aatmayu jeevamunaiyunnavi gaani
meelo vishva sinchanivaaru kondarunnaarani vaarithoo cheppenu. Vishva sinchanivaarevaro, thannu appagimpabovuvaadevado, modatinundi yesunaku teliyunu.
mariyu aayana thandrichetha vaaniki krupa anugrahimpabadakunte evadunu naayoddhaku raaledani yee hethuvunubatti meethoo cheppithinanenu.
appatinundi aayana shishyulalo anekulu venukatheesi, mari ennadunu aayananu vembadimpaledu.
kaabatti yesumeeru kooda vellipovalenani yunnaaraa? Ani pandrendumandhini adugagaa
seemonu pethuru prabhuvaa, yevaniyoddhaku velludumu? neeve nityajeevapu maatalu galavaadavu;
neeve dhevuni parishuddhudavani memu vishvasinchi yerigiyunnaamani aayanathoo cheppenu.
anduku yesu nenu mimmunu pandrendugurini erparachu konaledaa? meelo okadu saathaanu anivaarithoo cheppenu.
seemonu iskariyothu kumaarudaina yoodhaa pandrendu mandilo okadaiyundi aayana nappagimpabovu chundenu ganuka vaanigoorchiye aayana ee maata cheppenu.
atu tharuvaatha yoodulu aayananu champa vedaki nanduna yesu yoodayalo sancharinchanollaka galilayalo sancharinchuchundenu.
yoodula parnashaalala panduga sameepinchenu ganuka
aayana sahodarulu aayananu chuchineevu cheyuchunna kriyalu nee shishyulunu choochunatlu ee sthalamu vidichi yoodayaku vellumu.
bahirangamuna angeekarimpabada goruvaadevadunu thana pani rahasyamuna jarigimpadu. neevu ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnayedala ninnu neeve lokamunaku kanabarachukonumani cheppiri.
aayana sahodarulainanu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchaledu.
yesu naa samaya minkanu raaledu; mee samayamellappudunu siddhamugaane yunnadhi.
lokamu mimmunu dveshimpaneradugaani, daani kriyalu cheddavani nenu daaninigoorchi saakshyamichu chunnaanu ganuka adhi nannu dveshinchuchunnadhi.
meeru pandugaku velludi; naa samayaminkanu paripoornamu kaaledu ganuka nenu ee pandugaku ippude vellanani vaarithoo cheppenu.
aayana vaarithoo eelaaguna cheppi galilayalo nilichipoyenu.
ayithe aayana sahodarulu pandugaku vellipoyina tharuvaatha aayanakooda bahirangamugaa vellaka rahasyamugaa vellenu.
pandugalo yoodulu aayana ekkadanani aayananu vedakuchundiri.
mariyu janasamoohamulalo aayananugoorchi goppa sanugu puttenu; kondharaayana manchivaadaniri; marikondarukaadu, aayana janulanu mosapuchuvaadaniri;
ayithe yoodulaku bhayapadi aayananu goorchi yevadunu bahirangamugaa maatalaadaledu.
sagamu pandugainappudu yesu dhevaalayamuloniki velli bodhinchuchundenu.
yoodulu anduku aashcharyapadi chaduvukonani ithaniki ee paandityametlu vacchenani cheppukoniri.
anduku yesu nenu cheyu bodha naadhi kaadu; nannu pampinavaanidhe.
evadainanu aayana chitthamu choppuna cheya nishchayinchukoninayedala, aa bodha dhevunivalana kaliginado, leka naa yanthata nene bodhinchu chunnaano, vaadu telisikonunu.
thananthata thaane bodhinchuvaadu svakeeya mahimanu vedakunu gaani thannu pampinavaani mahi manu vedakuvaadu satyavanthudu, aayana yandu e durneethiyuledu.
moshe meeku dharmashaastramu iyyaledaa? Ayinanu meelo evadunu aa dharmashaastra munu gaikonadu; meerenduku nannu champa joochuchunnaarani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anduku janasamoohamu neevu dayyamu pattinavaadavu, evadu ninnu champa joochuchunnaadani adugagaa
yesu vaarini chuchi nenu oka kaaryamu chesithini; anduku meerandaru aashcharyapadu chunnaaru.
moshe meeku sunnathi sanskaaramunu niyaminchenu, ee sanskaaramu moshevalana kaliginadhi kaadu, pitharulavalanane kaliginadhi. Ayinanu vishraanthidinamuna meeru manushyuniki sunnathi cheyu chunnaaru.

moshe dharma shaastramu meerakundunatlu oka manushyudu vishraanthi dinamuna sunnathipondunu gadaa. Itlundagaa nenu vishraanthi dinamuna oka manushyuni poornasvasthathagala vaanigaa chesinanduku meeru naameeda aagrahapadu chunnaaremi?
velichoopunubatti theerpu theerchaka nyaayamaina theerpu theerchudanenu.
yerooshalemuvaarilo kondaru vaaru champa vedaku vaadu eeyane kaadaa?
idigo eeyana bahirangamugaa maatalaaduchunnanu eeyananu emanaru; eeyana kreesthani adhikaarulu nijamugaa telisikoniyunduraa?
ayinanu eeyana ekkadi vaado yerugudumu; kreesthu vachunappudu aayana yekkadivaado yevadunu erugadani cheppukoniri.
kaagaa yesu dhevaalayamulo bodhinchuchumeeru nanneruguduru; nenekkadivaadano yeruguduru; naa yanthata nene raaledu, nannu pampinavaadu satyavanthudu, aayananu meererugaru.
nenu aayana yoddhanundi vachithini;aayana nannu pampenu ganuka nenu aayananu erugudunani biggaragaa cheppenu.
anduku vaaraayananu pattukona yatnamuchesiri gaani aayana gadiya yinkanu raaledu ganuka evadunu aayananu pattu konaledu.
mariyu janasamoohamulo anekulu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchikreesthu vachunappudu eeyana chesinavaati kante ekkuvaina soochaka kriyalu cheyunaa ani cheppukoniri.
janasamoohamu aayananu goorchi yeelaagu sanugukonuta parisayyulu vininappudu, pradhaanayaajakulunu parisayyulunu aayananu pattukonutaku bantrauthulanu pampiri.
yesu inka konthakaalamu nenu meethookooda nundunu; tharuvaatha nannu pampinavaaniyoddhaku velludunu;
meeru nannu vedakuduru gaani nannu kanugonaru, nenekkada unduno akkadiki meeru raaleranenu.
anduku yoodulumanamu eeyananu kanugonakundunatlu eeyana ekkadiki vellabovuchunnaadu? Greesudheshasthulalo chedaripoyina vaariyoddhaku velli greesudheshasthulaku bodhinchunaa?
nannu vedakuduru gaani kanugonaru, nenekkada unduno akkadiki meeru raalerani aayana cheppina yee maata emito ani thamalothaamu cheppukonuchundiri.
aa pandugalo mahaadhinamaina antyadhinamuna yesu nilichi'evadainanu dappigonina yedala naayoddhaku vachi dappi theerchukonavalenu.
naayandu vishvaasamunchu vaadevado lekhanamu cheppinattu vaani kadupulonundi jeeva jalanadulu paarunani biggaragaa cheppenu.
thanayandu vishvaasamunchuvaaru ponda bovu aatmanugoorchi aayana ee maata cheppenu. Yesu inkanu mahimaparachabadaledu ganuka aatma inkanu anugrahimpabadiyundaledu.
janasamoohamulo kondaru ee maatalu vininijamugaa eeyana aa pravakthaye aniri;
marikondaru eeyana kreesthe aniri; marikondaru'emi? Kreesthu galilayalo nundi vachunaa?
kreesthu daaveedu santhaanamulo putti daaveedu undina betlehemanu graamamulonundi vachunani lekhanamu chepputaledaa aniri.
kaabatti aayananu goorchi janasamoohamulo bhedamu puttenu.
vaarilo kondaru aayananu pattukona dalachiri gaani yevadunu aayananu pattukonaledu.
aa bantrauthulu pradhaanayaajakulayoddhakunu parisayyulayoddhakunu vachinappudu vaaru'enduku mee raaya nanu theesikoni raaledani adugagaa
aa bantrauthulu aa manushyudu maatalaadinatlu evadunu ennadunu maata laadaledaniri.
anduku parisayyulu meerukooda mosa pothiraa?
adhikaarulalo gaani parisayyulalo gaani yevadainanu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchenaa?
ayithe dharmashaastra merugani yee janasamoohamu shaapagrasthamainadani vaarithoo aniri.
anthakumunupu aayanayoddhaku vachina neekodhemu vaarilo okadu.
athadu oka manushyuni maata vinakamunupunu, vaadu chesinadhi telisikonaka munupunu, mana dharmashaastramu athaniki theerpu theerchunaa ani adugagaa
vaaru neevunu galilayudavaa? Vichaarinchi choodumu, galilayalo e pravakthayu puttadaniri.
anthata evari yintiki vaaru velliri.
yesu oleevalakondaku vellenu.
tellavaaragaane yesu thirigi dhevaalayamuloniki raagaa prajalandaru aayana yoddhaku vachiri ganuka aayana koorchundi vaariki bodhinchu chundenu.
shaastrulunu parisayyulunu, vyabhichaaramandu pattabadina yoka streeni thoodu konivachi aamenu madhya niluvabetti
bodhakudaa, yee stree vyabhichaaramu cheyuchundagaa pattabadenu;
attivaarini raallu ruviva champavalenani dharmashaastramulo moshe mana kaagnaapinchenu gadaa; ayinanu neevemi cheppuchunnaavani aayana nadigiri.
aayanameeda neramu mopavalenani aayananu shodhinchuchu eelaaguna adigiri. Ayithe yesu vangi, nelameeda vrelithoo emo vraayuchundenu.
vaaraayananu pattuvadalaka aduguchundagaa aayana thalayetthi chuchimeelo paapamu lenivaadu mottamodata aamemeeda raayi veya vachunani vaarithoo cheppi
marala vangi nelameeda vraayu chundenu.
vaaraamaata vini, peddavaaru modalukoni chinnavaarivaraku okani venta okadu bayatiki velliri; yesu okkade migilenu; aa stree madhyanu niluvabadiyundenu.
yesu thalayetthi chuchi ammaa, vaarekkada unnaaru? Evarunu neeku shiksha vidhimpaledaa? Ani adiginappudu
aame ledu prabhuvaa anenu. Anduku yesu nenunu neeku shiksha vidhimpanu; neevu velli ika paapamu cheyakumani aamethoo cheppenu.
marala yesu nenu lokamunaku velugunu, nannu vembadinchuvaadu chikatilo naduvaka jeevapu velugugaligi yundunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
kaabatti parisayyulu ninnugoorchi neeve saakshyamu cheppukonuchunnaavu; nee saakshyamu satyamu kaadani aayanathoo anagaa

yesunenu ekkadanundi vachithino yekkadiki velluduno nenerugudunu ganuka nannugoorchi nenu saakshyamu cheppu koninanu naa saakshyamu satyame; nenu ekkadanundi vachuchunnaano yekkadiki velluchunnaano meeru erugaru.
meeru shareeramunubatti theerpu theerchuchunnaaru; nenevarikini theerpu theerchanu.
nenu okkadanaiyundaka, nenunu nannu pampina thandriyu kooda nunnaamu ganuka nenu theerpu theerchinanu naa theerpu satyame.
mariyu iddaru manushyula saakshyamu satyamani mee dharmashaastramulo vraayabadiyunnadhi gadaa.
nannugoorchi nenu saakshyamu cheppukonu vaadanu; nannu pampina thandriyu nannugoorchi saakshyamichuchunnaadani cheppenu.
vaaru nee thandri yekkada unnaadani aayananu adugagaa yesu meeru nannainanu naa thandrinainanu erugaru; nannu erigi yuntiraa naa thandrinikooda erigi yundurani vaarithoo cheppenu.
aayana dhevaalayamulo bodhinchuchundagaa, kaanuka pette yunnachoota ee maatalu cheppenu. aayana gadiya yinkanu raaledu ganuka evadunu aayananu pattukonaledu.
mariyokappudu aayananenu vellipovuchunnaanu; meeru nannu vedakuduru gaani mee paapamulone yundi chanipovuduru; nenu velluchootiki meeru raalerani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anduku yoodulunenu velluchootiki meeru raalerani yeeyana cheppuchunnaade; thannu thaane champu konunaa ani cheppukonuchundiri.
appudaayana meeru krindivaaru, nenu painunduvaadanu; meeru ee loka sambandhulu, nenu ee lokasambandhudanu kaanu.
kaagaa mee paapamulaloneyundi meeru chanipovudurani meethoo cheppithini. Nenu aayananani meeru vishvasinchaniyedala meeru mee paapamuloneyundi chanipovudurani vaarithoo cheppenu.
kaabatti vaarunee vevaravani aayana nadugagaa yesu vaarithoomodatanundi nenu meethoo evadanani cheppuchuntino vaadane.
mimmunugoorchi chepputakunu theerpu theerchutakunu chaala sangathulu naaku kalavu gaani nannu pampinavaadu satyavanthudu; nenu aayanayoddha vinina sangathule lokamunaku bodhinchuchunnaanani cheppenu.
thandrini goorchi thamathoo aayana cheppenani vaaru grahimpaka poyiri.
kaavuna yesu meeru manushyakumaaruni paiketthinappudu nene aayanananiyu, naa anthata nene yemiyu cheyaka, thandri naaku nerpinattu ee sangathulu maatalaaduchunnaananiyu meeru grahinchedaru.
nannu pampinavaadu naaku thoodaiyunnaadu; aayana kishtamaina kaaryamu nenellappudunu cheyudunu ganuka aayana nannu ontarigaa vidichipettaledani cheppenu.
aayana yee sangathulu maatalaaduchundagaa aneku laayanayandu vishvaasamunchiri.
kaabatti yesu, thananu nammina yoodulathoomeeru naa vaakyamandu nilichinavaaraithe nijamugaa naaku shishyulai yundi satyamunu grahinchedaru;
appudu satyamu mimmunu svathantrulanugaa cheyunani cheppagaa
vaarumemu abraahaamu santhaanamu, memu ennadunu evanikini daasulamai yundaledhe; meeru svathantrulugaa cheya badudurani yela cheppuchunnaavani aayanathoo aniri.
anduku yesupaapamu cheyu prathivaadunu paapamunaku daasudani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
daasudellappudunu intilo nivaasamucheyadu; kumaaru dellappudunu nivaasamucheyunu.
kumaarudu mimmunu svathantrulanugaa chesinayedala meeru nijamugaa svathantrulai yunduru.
meeru abraahaamu santhaanamani naaku teliyunu; ayinanu meelo naa vaakyamunaku chootuledu ganuka nannu champa vedakuchunnaaru.
nenu naa thandriyoddha chuchina sangathule bodhinchuchunnaanu; aa prakaarame meeru mee thandriyoddha vininavaatine jari ginchuchunnaarani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anduku vaaru aayanathoo maa thandri abraahaamaniri; yesumeeru abraahaamu pillalaithe abraahaamu chesina kriyalu chethuru.
dhevunivalana vinina satyamu meethoo cheppinavaadanaina nannu meerippudu champa vedakuchunnaare; abraahaamu atlu cheyaledu
meeru mee thandri kriyale cheyuchunnaarani vaarithoo cheppenu; anduku vaarumemu vyabhichaaramuvalana puttinavaaramu kaamu, dhevudokkade maaku thandri ani cheppagaa
yesu vaarithoo itlanenudhevudu mee thandriyainayedala meeru nannu preminthuru; nenu dhevuni yoddhanundi bayaludheri vachi yunnaanu, naa anthata nene vachiyundaledu, aayana nannu pampenu.
meerela naa maatalu grahimpakunnaaru? meeru naa bodha vinanerakundutavalananegadaa?

meeru mee thandriyagu apavaadhi sambandhulu; mee thandri duraashalu neravercha goruchunnaaru. aadhinundi vaadu narahantha kudaiyundi satyamandu nilichinavaadu kaadu; vaaniyandu satyameledu; vaadu abaddhamaadunappudu thana svabhaavamu anusarinchiye maatalaadunu; vaadu abaddhi kudunu abaddhamunaku janakudunai yunnaadu.
nenu satyamune cheppuchunnaanu ganuka meeru nannu nammaru.
naayandu paapamunnadani meelo evadu sthaapinchunu? Nenu satyamu cheppuchunnayedala meerenduku nannu nammaru?
dhevuni sambandhiyainavaadu dhevuni maatalu vinunu. meeru dhevuni sambandhulu kaaru ganukane meeru vinarani cheppenu.
anduku yoodulu neevu samarayu davunu dayyamupattinavaadavunu ani memu cheppumaata sariyegadaa ani aayanathoo cheppagaa
yesu nenu dayyamupattina vaadanu kaanu, naa thandrini ghanaparachuvaadanu; meeru nannu avamaanaparachuchunnaaru.
nenu naa mahimanu vedakutaledu; vedakuchu theerpu theerchuchu unduvaa dokadu kaladu.
okadu naa maata gaikonina yedala vaadennadunu maranamu pondadani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanani uttharamicchenu.

anduku yooduluneevu dayyamu pattinavaadavani yippuderugu dumu; abraahaamunu pravakthalunu chanipoyiri; ayinanu okadu naa maata gaikoninayedala vaadu ennadunu maranamu ruchichoodadani neevu cheppuchunnaavu.
mana thandriyaina abraahaamu chanipoyenu gadaa; neevathanikante goppavaadavaa? Pravakthalunu chanipoyiri; ninnu nee vevadavani cheppukonuchunnaavani aayana nadigiri.
anduku yesu nannu nene mahimaparachukoninayedala naa mahima vattidi; maa dhevudani meerevarinigoorchi cheppuduro aa naa thandriye nannu mahimaparachuchunnaadu.
meeru aayananu erugaru, nenaayananu erugudunu; aayananu eruganani nenu cheppinayedala meevale nenunu abaddhikudanai yundunu gaani, nenaayananu erugudunu, aayana maata gaikonuchunnaanu.
mee thandriyaina abraa haamu naa dinamu choothunani migula aanandinchenu; adhi chuchi santhooshinchenu anenu.
anduku yooduluneekinkanu ebadhi samvatsaramulaina leve, neevu abraahaamunu chuchithivaa ani aayanathoo cheppagaa,
yesu abraahaamu puttakamunupe nenu unnaanani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
kaabatti vaaru aayanameeda ruvvutaku raallu etthiri gaani yesu daagi dhevaalayamulo nundi bayatiki vellipoyenu.
aayana maargamuna povuchundagaa puttu gruddiyaina yoka manushyudu kanabadenu.
aayana shishyulu bodhakudaa, veedu gruddivaadai puttutaku evadu paapamu chesenu? Veedaa, veeni kannavaaraa? Ani aayananu adugagaa
yesu veedainanu veeni kannavaarainanu paapamu cheyaledu gaani, dhevuni kriyalu veeniyandu pratyakshaparachabadutake veedu gruddivaadugaa puttenu.
pagalunnanthavaraku nannu pampinavaani kriyalu manamu cheyuchundavalenu; raatri vachuchunnadhi, appudevadunu panicheyaledu.
nenu ee lokamulo unnappudu lokamunaku velugunani cheppenu.
aayana itlu cheppi nelameeda ummivesi, ummithoo buradachesi, vaani kannulameeda aa burada poosi
neevu siloyamu konetiki velli andulo kadugu konumani cheppenu. Siloyamanu maataku pampabadina vaadani arthamu. Vaadu velli kadugukoni choopu galavaadai vacchenu.
kaabatti poruguvaarunu, vaadu bhikshakudani anthakumundu chuchinavaarunuveedu koorchundi bhiksha metthukonuvaadu kaadaa aniri.
veede ani kondarunu, veedukaadu, veeni poliyunna yokadani marikondarunu aniri; vaadaithenene yanenu.
vaaru nee kannulelaagu teravabadenani vaani nadugagaa
vaadu yesu anu noka manushyudu burada chesi naa kannulameeda poosi neevu siloyamanu konetiki velli kadugukonumani naathoo cheppenu; nenu velli kadugukoni choopu pondithinanenu.
vaaru, aayana ekkadanani adugagaa vaadu, nenerugananenu.
anthakumundu gruddiyai yundinavaanini vaaru parisayyulayoddhaku theesikonipoyiri.
yesu buradachesi vaani kannulu terachina dinamu vishraanthidinamu
vaadelaagu choopupondeno daaninigoorchi parisayyulu kooda vaanini marala adugagaa vaadu naa kannulameeda aayana burada unchagaa nenu kadugu koni choopu pondithinani vaarithoo cheppenu.

kaagaa parisayyulalo kondaru ee manushyudu vishraanthidinamu aacharinchutaledu ganuka dhevuni yoddhanundi vachinavaadu kaadaniri. Marikondaru paapiyaina manushyudu eelaati soochakakriya lelaagu cheyagaladaniri; itlu vaarilo bhedamu puttenu.
kaabatti vaaru marala aa gruddivaanithoo athadu nee kannulu terachinanduku neevathanigoorchi yemanu konuchunnaavani yadugagaa vaadu aayana oka pravaktha anenu.
vaadu gruddi vaadaiyundi choopu pondenani yoodulu nammaka, choopu pondinavaani thalidandrulanu pilipinchi,
gruddivaadai puttenani meeru cheppu mee kumaarudu veedenaa? aalaagaithe ippudu veedelaagu choochu chunnaadani vaarini adigiri.
anduku vaani thalidandrulu veedu maa kumaarudaniyu veedu gruddivaadugaa puttenaniyu memerugudumu.
ippudu veedelaagu choochuchunnaado yerugamu; evadu veeni kannulu teracheno adhiyu memerugamu; veedu vayassu vachinavaadu, veenine adugudi; thana sangathi thaane cheppukonagaladani vaarithoo aniri.

vaani thalidandrulu yoodulaku bhayapadi aalaagu cheppiri; endukanina aayana kreesthu ani yevarainanu oppukoninayedala vaanini samaajamandiramulonundi veli vethumani yoodulu anthakumunupu nirnayinchukoni yundiri.
kaavuna vaani thalidandruluvaadu vayassu vachinavaadu; vaanini adugudaniri.
kaabatti vaaru gruddivaadaiyundina manushyuni rendava maaru pilipinchi dhevuni mahimaparachumu; ee manushyudu paapiyani memerugudumani vaanithoo cheppagaa
vaadu aayana paapiyo kaado neneruganu; okati maatramu nenerugu dunu; nenu gruddivaadanaiyundi ippudu choochuchunnaa nanenu.
anduku vaaru aayana neekemi chesenu? nee kannulu elaagu terachenani marala vaanini adugagaa
vaadu indaaka meethoo cheppithini gaani meeru vinakapothiri; meerenduku marala vinagoruchunnaaru? meerunu aayana shishyulagutaku koruchunnaaraa yemi ani vaarithoo anenu.
anduku vaaru neeve vaani shishyudavu, memu moshe shishyulamu;
dhevudu moshethoo maatalaadenani yerugudumu gaani veedekkadanundi vaccheno yerugamani cheppi vaanini dooshinchiri.
anduku aa manushyudu aayana ekkadanundi vaccheno meererugakapovuta aashcharyame; ayinanu aayana naa kannulu terachenu.
dhevudu paapula manavi aalakimpadani yerugudumu; evadainanu dhevabhakthudai yundi aayana chitthamuchoppuna jariginchinayedala aayana vaani manavi aalakinchunu.
puttu gruddivaani kannulevaraina terachinattu lokamu puttinappatinundi vinabadaledu.
eeyana dhevuni yoddha nundi vachinavaadu kaaniyedala emiyu cheyaneradani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anduku vaaru neevu kevalamu paapivai puttinavaadavu, neevu maaku bodhimpa vachithivaa ani vaanithoo cheppi vaani velivesiri.
parisayyulu vaanini velivesirani yesu vini vaanini kanugoni neevu dhevuni kumaaruniyandu vishvaasamunchu chunnaavaa ani adigenu.
anduku vaadu prabhuvaa, nenu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchutaku aayana evadani adugagaa
yesu neevaayananu choochuchunnaavu; neethoo maatalaaduchunnavaadu aayane anenu.
anthata vaadu prabhuvaa, nenu vishvasinchuchunnaanani cheppi aayanaku mrokkenu.
appudu yesu choodanivaaru choodavalenu, choochuvaaru gruddivaaru kaavalenu, anu theerpu nimitthamu neneelokamunaku vachithinani cheppenu.
aayana yoddhanunna parisayyulalo kondaru ee maata vinimemunu gruddivaaramaa ani adigiri.
anduku yesu meeru gruddivaaraithe meeku paapamu leka povunu gaani choochuchunnaamani meerippudu cheppu konuchunnaaru ganuka mee paapamu nilichiyunnadani cheppenu.
gorrela doddilo dvaaramuna praveshimpaka verokamaargamuna ekkuvaadu dongayu dochukonuvaadunaiyunnaadu.
dvaaramuna praveshinchuvaadu gorrela kaapari.
athaniki dvaarapaalakudu thalupu theeyunu, gorrelu athani svaramu vinunu, athadu thana sontha gorrelanu perupetti pilichi vaatini velupaliki nadi pinchunu.
mariyu athadu thana sontha gorrelanannitini velupaliki nadipinchunapudella vaatiki mundhugaa naduchunu; gorrelu athani svaramerugunu ganuka avi athanini vemba dinchunu.
anyula svaramu avi yerugavu ganuka anyuni enthamaatramunu vembadimpaka vaaniyoddhanundi paaripovunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo anenu.
ee saadrushyamu yesu vaarithoo cheppenu gaani aayana thamathoo cheppina sangathulettivo vaaru grahinchukonaledu.
kaabatti yesu marala vaarithoo itlanenu
gorrelu povu dvaaramunu nene; naaku mundu vachina vaarandaru dongalunu dochukonuvaarunai yunnaaru; gorrelu vaari svaramu vinaledu.
nene dvaaramunu; naa dvaaraa evadaina lopala praveshinchina yedala vaadu rakshimpabadinavaadai, lopaliki povuchu bayatiki vachuchu metha meyuchunundunu.

donga dongathanamunu hatyanu naashanamunu cheyutaku vachunu gaani maridhenikini raadu; gorrelaku jeevamu kalugutakunu adhi samrudhdhigaa kalugutakunu nenu vachithinani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
nenu gorrelaku manchi kaaparini; manchi kaapari gorrelakoraku thana praanamu pettunu.
jeethagaadu gorrela kaaparikaadu ganuka gorrelu thanavikaananduna thoodelu vachuta chuchi gorrelanu vidichipetti paaripovunu, thoodelu aa gorrelanu patti chedharagottunu.
jeethagaadu jeethagaade ganuka gorrelanugoorchi lakshyamu cheyaka paaripovunu.
nenu gorrela manchi kaaparini.
thandri nannu elaaguna eruguno nenu thandrini elaagu eruguduno aalaage nenu naa gorrelanu erugudunu, naa gorrelu nannu erugunu. Mariyu gorrelakoraku naa praanamu pettuchunnaanu.
ee doddivikaani vere gorrelunu naaku kalavu; vaatinikooda nenu thoodukoni raavalenu, avi naa svaramu vinunu, appudu manda okkatiyu gorrela kaapari okkadunu agunu.
nenu daani marala theesikonunatlu naa praanamu pettuchunnaanu; indu valanane naa thandri nannu preminchuchunnaadu.

evadunu naa praanamu theesikonadu; naa anthata nene daani pettuchunnaanu; daani pettutaku naaku adhikaaramu kaladu, daani thirigi theesikonutakunu naaku adhikaaramu kaladu; naa thandrivalana ee aagna pondithinanenu.
ee maatalanubatti yoodulalo marala bhedamu puttenu.
vaarilo anekuluvaadu dayyamu pattina vaadu, verrivaadu; vaani maata enduku vinuchunnaaraniri.
mari kondaru'ivi dayyamu pattinavaani maatalukaavu; dayyamu gruddivaari kannulu teravagaladaa aniri.
aalaya prathishthithapanduga yerooshalemulo jarugu chundenu.
adhi sheethakaalamu. Appudu yesu dhevaala yamulo solomonu mantapamuna thiruguchundagaa
yoodulu aayanachuttu pogai'enthakaalamu mammunu sandhehapettuduvu? neevu kreesthuvaithe maathoo spashtamugaa cheppumaniri.
anduku yesumeethoo cheppithini gaani meeru nammaru, nenu naa thandri naamamandu cheyuchunna kriyalu nannu goorchi saakshyamichuchunnavi.
ayithe meeru naa gorrelalo cherinavaarukaaru ganuka meeru nammaru.
naa gorrelu naa svaramu vinunu, nenu vaati nerugudunu, avi nannu vembadinchunu.
nenu vaatiki nityajeevamu nichuchunnaanu ganuka avi ennatikini nashimpavu, evadunu vaatini naa chethilonundi apaha rimpadu.
vaatini naakichina naa thandri andarikante goppavaadu ganuka naa thandri chethilonundi yevadunu vaatini apaharimpaledu;
nenunu thandriyunu ekamai yunnaamani vaarithoo cheppenu.
yoodulu aayananu kottavalenani marala raalluchetha pattukonagaa
yesu thandri yoddhanundi anekamaina manchi kriyalanu meeku choopithini; vaatilo e kriya nimitthamu nannu raallathoo kottudurani vaarinadigenu.
anduku yooduluneevu manushyudavai yundi dhevudanani cheppukonuchunnaavu ganuka dhevadooshana chesinanduke ninnu raallathoo kottudumu gaani manchi kriya chesinanduku kaadani aayanathoo cheppiri.
anduku yesu meeru daivamulani nenantinani mee dharmashaastramulo vraayabadiyundaledaa?
lekhanamu nirarthakamu kaaneradu gadaa, dhevuni vaakyamevariki vaccheno vaare daivamulani cheppinayedala nenu dhevuni kumaarudanani cheppinanduku,
thandri prathishthachesi yee lokamuloniki pampinavaanithoo neevu dhevadooshana cheyuchunnaavani cheppuduraa?
nenu naathandri kriyalu cheyaniyedala nannu nammakudi,
chesinayedala nannu nammakunnanu, thandri naayandunu nenu thandriyandunu unnaamani meeru grahinchi telisi konunatlu aa kriyalanu nammudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru marala aayananu pattukona chuchiri gaani aayana vaari chethinundi thappinchukoni poyenu.
yordaanu addarini yohaanu modata baapthismamichu chundina sthalamunaku aayana thirigi velli akkadanundenu.
anekulu aayanayoddhaku vachi yohaanu e soochaka kriyanu cheyaledu gaani yeeyananugoorchi yohaanu cheppina sangathulanniyu satyamaina vaniri.
akkada anekulu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchiri.
mariya, aame sahodariyaina maartha, anuvaari graamamaina bethaniyalonunna laajaru anu okadu rogi yaayenu.
ee laajaru prabhuvunaku attharupoosi thala vendrukalathoo aayana paadamulu thudichina mariyaku sahodarudu.
athani akka chellendru prabhuvaa, yidigo neevu preminchuvaadu rogiyai yunnaadani aayanayoddhaku varthamaanamu pampiri.
yesu adhi viniyee vyaadhi maranamukoraku vachinadhikaadu gaani dhevuni kumaarudu daanivalana mahima parachabadunatlu dhevuni mahimakoraku vachinadanenu.
yesu maarthanu aame sahodarini laajarunu preminchenu.
athadu rogiyai yunnaadani yesu vininappudu thaanunnachootane yinka rendu dinamulu nilichenu.
atupimmata aayanamanamu yoodayaku thirigi velludamani thana shishyulathoo cheppagaa
aayana shishyulubodhakudaa, yippude yoodulu ninnu raallathoo kotta choochuchundire; akkadiki thirigi velluduvaa ani aayana nadigiri.
anduku yesu pagalu pandrendu gantalunnavi gadaa, okadu pagativela nadichina yedala ee lokapu velugunu choochunu ganuka totru padadu.
ayithe raatrivela okadu nadichinayedala vaaniyandu veluguledu ganuka vaadu totrupadunani cheppenu.
aayana yee maatalu cheppina tharuvaathamana snehithudaina laajaru nidrinchuchunnaadu; athani melu kolupa velluchunnaanani vaarithoo cheppagaa
shishyulu prabhuvaa, athadu nidrinchinayedala baagupadunaniri.
yesu athani maranamunugoorchi aa maata cheppenu gaani vaaru aayana nidra vishraanthini goorchi cheppenanukoniri.
kaavuna yesu laajaru chanipoyenu,
meeru nammunatlu nenakkada undaledani mee nimitthamu santhooshinchuchunnaanu; ayinanu athaniyoddhaku manamu velludamu randani spashtamugaa vaarithoo cheppenu.
anduku diduma anabadina thoomaa aayanathoo kooda chanipovutaku manamunu velludamani thanathoodi shishyulathoo cheppenu.
yesu vachi adhivarake athadu naalugu dinamulu samaadhilo undenani telisikonenu.
bethaniya yerooshalemunaku sameepamai yundenu; daaniki inchuminchu kosedu dooramu
ganuka yoodulalo anekulu vaari sahodarunigoorchi maarthanu mariyanu odaarchutakai vaari yoddhaku vachiyundiri.
maartha yesu vachuchunnaadani vini aayananu edurkona vellenugaani mariya yintilo koorchundi yundenu.
maartha yesuthoo prabhuvaa, neevikkada undinayedala naa sahodarudu chaavakundunu.
ippudainanu neevu dhevuni emadiginanu dhevudu neekanu grahinchunani yerugudunanenu.
yesu nee sahodarudu marala lechunani aamethoo cheppagaa
maartha aayanathoo antya dinamuna punarut'thaanamandu lechunani yerugudunanenu.
anduku yesu punarut'thaanamunu jeevamunu nene; naayandu vishvaasamunchuvaadu chani poyinanu bradukunu;
bradhiki naayandu vishvaasa munchu prathivaadunu ennatikini chanipodu. ee maata nammuchunnaavaa? Ani aamenu nadigenu.
aame avunu prabhuvaa, neevu lokamunaku raavalasina dhevuni kumaarudavaina kreesthuvani nammuchunnaanani aayanathoo cheppenu.
aame ee maata cheppi vellibodhakudu vachi ninnu piluchuchunnaadani thana sahodariyaina mariyanu rahasya mugaa pilichenu.
aame vini tvaragaa lechi aayana yoddhaku vacchenu.
yesu inkanu aa graamamuloniki raaka, maartha aayananu kalisikonina chootane undenu
ganuka yintilo mariyathoo kooda nundi aamenu odaarchuchundina yoodulu mariya tvaragaa lechi velluta chuchi, aame samaadhiyoddha edchutaku akkadiki velluchunnadanukoni aame venta velliri.
anthata mariya yesu unna chootiki vachi, aayananu chuchi, aayana paadamulameeda padiprabhuvaa, neevikkada undinayedala naa sahodarudu chaavakundu nanenu.
aame edchutayu, aamethoo kooda vachina yoodulu edchutayu yesu chuchi kalavarapadi aatmalo mooluguchu athani nekkada nunchithirani adugagaa,
vaaruprabhuvaa, vachi choodumani aayanathoo cheppiri.
yesu kanneellu vidichenu.
kaabatti yoodulu athanini elaagu premincheno choodudani cheppukoniri.
vaarilo kondaru'aa gruddi vaani kannulu terachina yeeyana, yithanini chaavakunda cheyaledaa ani cheppiri.
yesu marala thanalo mooluguchu samaadhiyoddhaku vacchenu. adhi yoka guha, daanimeeda oka raayi pettiyundenu.
yesu raayi theesiveyudani cheppagaa chanipoyinavaani sahodariyaina maarthaprabhuvaa, athadu chanipoyi naalugu dinamulainadhi ganuka ippatiki vaasanakottunani aayanathoo cheppenu.
anduku yesu neevu namminayedala dhevuni mahima choothuvani nenu neethoo cheppaledaa ani aamethoo anenu;
anthata vaaru aa raayi theesivesiri. Yesu kannulu paiketthi thandree, neevu naa manavi vininanduna neeku krutha gnathaasthuthulu chellinchuchunnaanu.
neevu ellappudunu naa manavi vinuchunnaavani nenerugudunu gaani neevu nannu pampithivani chuttu nilichiyunna yee janasamoohamu nammunatlu vaari nimitthamai yee maata cheppithinanenu.
aayana aalaagu cheppilaajaroo, bayatiki rammani biggaragaa cheppagaa

chanipoyinavaadu, kaallu chethulu pretha vastramulathoo kattabadinavaadai velupaliki vacchenu; athani mukhamunaku rumaalu kattiyundenu. Anthata yesu meeru athani katlu vippiponiyyudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
kaabatti mariyayoddhaku vachi aayana chesina kaarya munu chuchina yoodulalo anekulu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchirikaani
vaarilo kondaru parisayyula yoddhaku velli yesuchesina kaaryamulanu goorchi vaarithoo cheppiri.
kaabatti pradhaanayaajakulunu parisayyulunu mahaa sabhanu samakoorchimanamemi cheyuchunnaamu? ee manu shyudu anekamaina soochaka kriyalu cheyuchunnaade.
manamaayananu eelaagu choochuchu oorakundinayedala andaru aayanayandu vishvaasamunchedaru; appudu romeeyulu vachi mana sthalamunu mana janamunu aakra minchukondurani cheppiri.
ayithe vaarilo kayapa anu okadu aa samvatsaramu pradhaana yaajakudaiyundimee kemiyu teliyadu.
mana janamanthayu nashimpa kundunatlu oka manushyudu prajalakoraku chanipovuta meeku upayukthamani meeru aalochinchukonaru ani vaarithoo cheppenu.
thananthata thaane yeelaagu cheppaledu gaani aa samvatsaramu pradhaanayaajakudai yundenu ganuka
yesu aa janamukorakunu, aa janamukoraku maatramegaaka chedaripoyina dhevuni pillalanu ekamugaa samakoorchutakunu, chaavanaiyunnaadani pravachinchenu.
kaagaa aa dinamunundi vaaru aayananu champa naalo chinchuchundiri.
kaabatti yesu appatinundi yoodulalo bahiranga mugaa sancharimpaka, akkadanundi aranyamunaku sameepa pradheshamulonunna ephraayimanu ooriki velli, akkada thana shishyulathookooda undenu.
mariyu yoodula paskaapanduga sameepamai yundenu ganuka anekulu thammunuthaamu shuddhichesikonutakai paskaa raakamunupe palle toollalonundi yerooshalemunaku vachiri.
vaaru yesunu vedakuchu dhevaalayamulo niluvabadi meekemi thoochuchunnadhi? aayana pandugaku raadaa yemi? Ani okanithoo okadu cheppukoniri.
pradhaanayaajakulunu parisayyulunu aayana ekkada unnadhi evanikainanu telisiyunna yedala thaamu aayananu pattukona galugutaku thamaku teliyajeyavalenani aagnaapinchi yundiri.
kaabatti yesu thaanu mruthulalonundi lepina laajaru unna bethaniyaku paskaapandugaku aaru dinamulu mundhugaa vacchenu. Akkada vaaru aayanaku vindu chesiri.
maartha upachaaramu chesenu; laajaru aayanathoo kooda bhojamunaku koorchunnavaarilo okadu.

appudu mariya mikkili viluvagala accha jataamaansi attharu oka serunnara yetthu theesikoni,yesu paadamulaku poosi thana thalavendrukalathoo aayana paadamulu thudichenu; illu aa attharu vaasanathoo nindenu
aayana shishyulalo okadu anagaa aayananu appagimpanaiyunna iskariyothu yoodhaa
yee attharenduku moodu vandala dhenaara mulaku ammi beedalaku iyyaledanenu.
vaadeelaagu cheppinadhi beedalameeda shradhdhakaligi kaadugaani vaadu dongayai yundi, thana daggara dabbu sanchiyundinanduna andulo veyabadinadhi dongilinchuchu vacchenu ganuka aalaagu cheppenu.
kaabatti yesunannu paathipettu dinamunaku aamenu deeni nunchukonaniyyudi;
beedalu ellappu dunu meethoo kooda undurugaani nenellappudu meethoo undanani cheppenu.
kaabatti yoodulalo saamaanyajanulu aayana akkada unnaadani telisikoni, yesunu choochutaku maatrame gaaka mruthulalonundi aayana lepina laajarunukooda choodavachiri.
athaninibatti yoodulalo anekulu thamavaarini vidichi yesunandu vishvaasa munchiri ganuka
pradhaanayaajakulu laajarunukooda champa naalochanachesiri.
marunaadu aa pandugaku vachina bahu janasamoo hamu yesu yerooshalemunaku vachuchunnaadani vini
kharjoorapumattalu pattukoni aayananu edurkonaboyi jayamu, prabhuvu perata vachuchunna ishraayelu raaju sthuthimpabadunugaaka ani kekaluvesiri.
seeyonu kumaaree, bhayapadakumu, idigo nee raaju gaadidapillameeda aaseenudai vachuchunnaadu
ani vraayabadina prakaaramu yesu oka chinna gaadidhanu kanugoni daanimeeda koorchundenu.
aayana shishyulu ee maatalu modata grahimpaledu gaani yesu mahima parachabadinappudu avi aayananu goorchi vraayabadenaniyu, vaaraayanaku vaatini chesiraniyu gnaapakamunaku techu koniri.
aayana laajarunu samaadhilonundi pilichi mruthu lalonundi athani lepinappudu, aayanathoo kooda undina janulu saakshyamichiri.
anduchetha aayana aa soochaka kriya chesenani janulu vini aayananu edurkona boyiri.
kaavuna parisayyulu okarithoo okaru mana prayatnamuletlu nish‌prayojanamai poyinavo choodudi. Idigo lokamu aayanaventa poyinadani cheppukoniri.
aa pandugalo aaraadhimpavachinavaarilo kondaru greesudheshasthulu undiri.
vaaru galilayaloni betsayidaa vaadaina philippunoddhaku vachi ayyaa, memu yesunu choodagoruchunnaamani athanithoo cheppagaa
philippu vachi andreyathoo cheppenu, andreyayu philippunu vachi yesuthoo cheppiri.
anduku yesu vaarithoo itlanenu manushyakumaarudu mahima pondavalasina gadiya vachi yunnadhi.
godhumaginja bhoomilo padi chaavakundina yedala adhi ontigaane yundunu; adhi chachina yedala visthaaramugaa phalinchunu.
thana praanamunu preminchu vaadu daanini pogottukonunu, ee lokamulo thana praanamunu dveshinchuvaadu nityajeevamukoraku daanini kaapaadukonunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
okadu nannu sevinchinayedala nannu vembadimpavalenu; appudu nenu ekkada unduno akkada naa sevakudunu undunu; okadu nannu sevinchinayedala naa thandri athani ghanaparachunu.
ippudu naa praanamu kalavarapaduchunnadhi; ne nemandunu?thandree, yee gadiya thatasthimpakundanannu thappinchumu; ayi nanu indukosarame nenu ee gadiyaku vachithini;
thandree, nee naamamu mahimaparachu mani cheppenu. Anthatanenu daanini mahimaparachithini, marala mahima parathunu ani yoka shabdamu aakaashamu nundi vacchenu.
kaabatti akkada niluchundi vinina jana samoohamu urimenu aniri. Marikondaru dhevadootha okadu aayanathoo maatalaadenaniri.
anduku yesu ee shabdamu naakoraku raaledu, meekorake vacchenu.
ippudu ee lokamunaku theerpu jaruguchunnadhi, ippudu ee lokaadhikaari bayataku trosiveyabadunu;
nenu bhoomimeedanundi paiketthabadinayedala andarini naayoddhaku aakarshinchukondunani cheppenu.
thaanu evidhamugaa maranamu pondavalasi yundeno soochinchuchu aayana ee maata cheppenu.

janasamoohamu kreesthu ellappudu undunani dharmashaastramu chepputa vintimi. Manushyakumaarudu paiketthabadavalenani neevu cheppuchunna sangathi emiti? Manushya kumaarudagu eeyana evarani aayana nadigiri.
anduku yesu'inka konthakaalamu velugu mee madhya undunu; chikati mimmunu kammukonakundunatlu meeku velugu undagane nadavudi; chikatilo naduchuvaadu thaanu ekkadiki povuchunnaado yerugadu.
meeru velugu sambandhulagunatlu meeku velugundagane velugunandu vishvaasamunchudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
yesu ee maatalu cheppi velli vaariki kanabadakunda daagiyundenu. aayana vaari yeduta yinni soochaka kriyalu chesinanu vaaraayanayandu vishvaasamuncharairi.
prabhuvaa, maa varthamaanamu namminavaadevadu? Prabhuvuyokka baahuvu evaniki bayaluparacha badenu? Ani pravakthayaina yeshayaa cheppina vaakyamu neraverunatlu idi jarigenu.
induchetha vaaru nammaleka poyiri, yelayanagaa

vaaru kannulathoo chuchi hrudayamuthoo grahinchi manassu maarchukoni naavalana svasthaparachabadakundu natlu aayana vaari kannulaku andhatvamu kalugajesi vaari hrudayamu kathinaparachenu ani yeshayaa mariyoka choota cheppenu.
yeshayaa aayana mahimanu chuchinanduna aayananugoorchi ee maatalu cheppenu.
ayinanu adhikaarulalo kooda anekulu aayanayandu vishvaasamunchirigaani, samaajamulo nundi veliveyabadudumemo yani parisayyulaku bhayapadi vaaru oppukonaledu.
vaaru dhevuni meppukante manushyula meppunu ekkuvagaa apekshinchiri.
anthata yesu biggaragaa itlanenunaayandu vishvaasa munchuvaadu naayandu kaadu nannu pampinavaaniyandhe vishvaasamunchuchunnaadu.
nannu choochuvaadu nannu pampinavaanine choochuchunnaadu.
naayandu vishvaasamunchu prathivaadu chikatilo nilichi yundakundunatlu nenu ee lokamunaku velugugaa vachiyunnaanu.
evadainanu naa maatalu viniyu vaatini gaikonakundina yedala ne nathaniki theerputheerchanu; nenu lokamunaku theerpu theerchutaku raaledu gaani lokamunu rakshinchutake vachi thini.
nannu niraakarinchi naa maatalanu angeekarimpani vaaniki theerpu theerchuvaadokadu kaladu; nenu cheppinamaataye antyadhinamandu vaaniki theerpu theerchunu.
yelayanagaa naa anthata nene maatalaadaledu; nenu emanavaleno yemi maatalaadavaleno daaninigoorchi nannu pampina thandriye naakaagna yichiyunnaadu.
mariyu aayana aagna nityajeevamani nenerugudunu ganuka nenu cheppu sangathulanu thandri naathoo cheppina prakaaramu cheppuchunnaananenu.
thaanu ee lokamunundi thandriyoddhaku vellavalasina gadiya vacchenani yesu paskaapandugaku mundhe yerigina vaadai, lokamulonunna thanavaarini preminchi, vaarini anthamuvaraku preminchenu.
vaaru bhojanamu cheyuchundagaa aayananu appagimpavalenani seemonu kumaaru dagu iskariyothu yoodhaa hrudayamulo apavaadhi inthakumundu aalochana puttinchiyundenu ganuka
thandri thanachethiki samasthamu appaginchenaniyu, thaanu dhevuniyoddha nundi bayaludheri vacchenaniyu, dhevuniyoddhaku vellavalasi yunnadaniyu yesu erigi
bhojanapankthilonundi lechi thana paivastramu avathala pettivesi, yoka thuvaalu theesikoni nadumunaku kattukonenu.
anthata pallemulo neellu posi shishyula paadamulu kadugutakunu, thaanu kattukoni yunna thuvaaluthoo thuduchutakunu modalupettenu.
itlu cheyuchu aayana seemonu pethurunoddhaku vachinappudu athadu prabhuvaa, neevu naa paadamulu kaduguduvaa? Ani aayanathoo anenu.
anduku yesu nenu cheyuchunnadhi ippudu neeku teliyadugaani yikameedata telisikonduvani athanithoo cheppagaa
pethuru neevennadunu naa paadamulu kadugaraadani aayanathoo anenu. Anduku yesu nenu ninnu kaduganiyedala naathoo neeku paalu ledanenu.
seemonu pethuru prabhuvaa, naa paadamulu maatramegaaka naa chethulu naa thalakooda kadugumani aayanathoo cheppenu.
yesu athani chuchi snaanamuchesinavaadu paadamulu thappa maremiyu kadugu kona nakkaraledu, athadu kevalamu pavitrudayyenu. meerunu pavitrulu kaani meelo andaru pavitrulu kaaranenu.
thannu appaginchuvaanini erigenu ganuka meelo andaru pavitrulu kaarani aayana cheppenu.
vaari paadamulu kadigi thana paivastramu vesikonina tharuvaatha, aayana marala koorchundi nenu meeku chesina pani meeku telisinadaa?
bodhakudaniyu prabhuvaniyu meeru nannu piluchuchunnaaru; nenu bodhakudanu prabhuvunu ganuka meeritlu piluchuta nyaayame.
kaabatti prabhuvunu bodhakudanaina nenu mee paadamulu kadigina yedala meerunu okari paadamulanu okaru kadugavalasinadhe.
nenu meeku chesina prakaaramu meerunu cheyavalenani meeku maadhirigaa eelaagu chesithini.
daasudu thana yajamaanunikante goppavaadu kaadu, pampabadinavaadu thannu pampina vaanikante goppavaadu kaadani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
ee sangathulu meeru eruguduru ganuka veetini chesinayedala meeru dhanyulagu duru.

mimmu nandarinigoorchi nenu cheppaledu; nenu erparachukoninavaarini erugudunu gaani naathoo kooda bhojanamucheyuvaadu naaku virodhamugaa thana madama yettenu anu lekhanamu neraverutakai yeelaagu jarugunu.
jarigi nappudu nene aayananani meeru nammunatlu adhi jarugaka munupu meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
nenevani pampuduno vaani cherchukonuvaadu nannu cherchukonuvaadagunu; nannu cherchukonuvaadu nannu pampinavaanini cherchukonuvaadagu nani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo anenu.
yesu ee maatalu palikina tharuvaatha aatmalo kalavara padimeelo okadu nannu appaginchunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanani roodhigaa cheppenu
aayana yevarinigoorchi yeelaagu cheppeno ani shishyulu sandheha paduchu okarithattu okaru choochu konuchundagaa
aayana shishyulalo yesu preminchina yokadu yesu rommuna aanukonuchundenu
ganuka evarinigoorchi aayana cheppeno adhi thamaku cheppumani seemonu pethuru athaniki saiga chesenu.
athadu yesu rommuna aanukonuchu prabhuvaa, vaadevadani aayananu adigenu.
anduku yesu nenoka mukka munchi yevani kicchedano vaade ani cheppi, oka mukka munchi seemonu kumaarudagu iskariyothu yoodhaakicchenu;
vaadu aa mukka puchukonagaane saathaanu vaanilo praveshinchenu. Yesuneevu cheyuchunnadhi tvaragaa cheyumani vaanithoo cheppagaa
aayana endunimitthamu athanithoo aalaagu cheppeno adhi bhojana munaku koorchundinavaarilo evanikini teliyaledu.
dabbu sanchi yoodhaayoddha undenu ganuka pandugaku thamaku kaavalasinavaatini konumani yainanu, beedalakemaina immani yainanu yesu vaanithoo cheppinattu kondharanukoniri.
vaadu aa mukka puchukoni ventane bayatiki vellenu; appudu raatrivela.
vaadu vellina tharuvaatha yesu itlanenu ippudu manushyakumaarudu mahimaparachabadi yunnaadu; dhevu dunu aayanayandu mahimaparachabadi yunnaadu.
dhevudu aayanayandu mahimaparachabadinayedala, dhevudu thanayandu aayananu mahimaparachunu; ventane aayananu mahimaparachunu.
pillalaaraa, yinka konthakaalamu meethoo kooda undunu, meeru nannu vedakuduru, nenekkadiki velluduno akkadiki meeru raalerani nenu yoodulathoo cheppinaprakaaramu ippudu meethoonu cheppuchunnaanu.
meeru okari nokaru premimpavalenani meeku krottha aagna ichuchunnaanu; nenu mimmunu preminchi natte meerunu okari nokaru premimpavalenu.
meeru okaniyedala okadu premagalavaaraina yedala deenibatti meeru naa shishyulani andarunu telisikonduranenu.
seemonu pethuru-prabhuvaa, neevekkadiki vellu chunnaavani aayananu adugagaa yesunenu velluchunnachootiki neevippudu naaventa raalevugaani, tharuvaatha vacchedavani athanithoo cheppenu.
anduku pethuru prabhuvaa, nenenduku ippudu nee venta raalenu? neekoraku naa praanamupettudunani aayanathoo cheppagaa
yesunaa koraku nee praanamu pettuduvaa? aayananu eruganani neevu mummaaru cheppakamundu kodikooyadani neethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
mee hrudayamunu kalavarapadaniyyakudi; dhevuni yandu vishvaasamunchuchunnaaru naayandunu vishvaasa munchudi.
naa thandri yinta aneka nivaasamulu kalavu, leniyedala meethoo cheppudunu; meeku sthalamu siddhaparacha velluchunnaanu.
nenu velli meeku sthalamu siddhaparachinayedala nenundu sthalamulo meerunu undulaaguna marala vachi naayoddha nundutaku mimmunu theesikoni povudunu.
nenu velluchunna sthalamunaku maargamu meeku teliyunani cheppenu.
anduku thoomaa prabhuvaa, yekkadiki velluchunnaavo maaku teliyadhe; aa maargamelaagu teliyunani aayana nadugagaa
yesu nene maargamunu, satyamunu, jeevamunu; naa dvaaraane thappa yevadunu thandriyoddhaku raadu.
meeru nannu erigiyunte naa thandrini erigiyunduru; ippatinundi meeraayananu eruguduru, aayananu chuchiyunnaarani cheppenu.
appudu philippuprabhuvaa, thandrini maaku kanabarachumu,maakanthe chaalunani aayanathoo cheppagaa
yesu philippoo, neninthakaalamu mee yoddha undinanu neevu nannu erugavaa? Nannu chuchina vaadu thandrini chuchiyunnaadu ganuka thandrini maaku kanuparachumani yela cheppuchunnaavu?
thandri yandu nenunu naayandu thandriyu unnaamani neevu nammutaledaa? Nenu meethoo cheppuchunna maatalu naa yanthata nene chepputaledu, thandri naayandu nivasinchuchu thana kriyalucheyu chunnaadu.
thandriyandu nenunu naayandu thandriyu unnaamani nammudi; ledaa yee kriyala nimitthamainanu nannu nammudi.
nenu thandriyoddhaku velluchunnaanu ganuka nenu cheyu kriyalu naayandu vishvaasamunchu vaadunu cheyunu, vaatikante mari goppaviyu athadu cheyunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
meeru naa naamamuna dheni naduguduro thandri kumaaruni yandu mahimaparachabadutakai daanini chethunu.
naa naamamuna meeru nannemi adiginanu nenu chethunu.
meeru nannu preminchina yedala naa aagnalanu gaikonduru.
nenu thandrini vedukondunu, meeyoddha ellappudu nundu takai aayana veroka aadharanakarthanu, anagaa satyasvaroopi yagu aatmanu meekanugrahinchunu.
lokamu aaya nanu choodadu, aayananu erugadu ganuka aayananu ponda neradu; meeru aayananu eruguduru. aayana meethoo kooda nivasinchunu, meelo undunu.
mimmunu anaathalanugaa viduvanu, mee yoddhaku vatthunu. Konthakaalamaina tharuvaatha lokamu nannu mari ennadunu choodadu;
ayithe meeru nannu choothuru. Nenu jeevinchuchunnaanu ganuka meerunu jeevinthuru.
nenu naa thandriyandunu, meeru naayandunu, nenu meeyandunu unnaamani aa dinamuna meereruguduru.
naa aagnalanu angeekarinchi vaatini gaikonuvaade nannu preminchuvaadu; nannu preminchuvaadu naa thandrivalana premimpabadunu; nenunu vaanini preminchi, vaaniki nannu kanabarachukondunani cheppenu.
iskariyothu kaani yoodhaa prabhuvaa, neevu lokamunaku kaaka maaku maatrame ninnu neevu kanabarachukonutakemi sambhavinchenani adugagaa
yesu okadu nannu preminchina yedala vaadu naa maata gaikonunu, appudu naa thandri vaanini preminchunu, memu vaani yoddhakuvachi vaaniyoddha nivaasamu chethumu.
nannu premimpani vaadu naa maatalu gaikonadu; meeru vinuchunna maata naamaata kaadu, nannu pampina thandridhe.
nenu meeyoddha undagaane yee maatalu meethoo cheppithini.
aadharanakartha, anagaa thandri naa naamamuna pampabovu parishuddhaatma samasthamunu meeku bodhinchi nenu meethoo cheppina sangathulannitini meeku gnaapakamu cheyunu.
shaanthi mee kanugrahinchi velluchunnaanu; naa shaanthine mee kanugrahinchuchunnaanu; lokamichu nattugaa nenu mee kanugrahinchutaledu; mee hrudaya munu kalavarapadaniyyakudi, veravaniyyakudi.

nenu velli meeyoddhaku vacchedhanani meethoo cheppina maata meeru vintirigadaa. thandri naakante goppavaadu ganuka meeru nannu preminchinayedala nenu thandriyoddhaku vellu chunnaanani meeru santhooshinthuru.
ee sangathi sambhavinchinappudu, meeru nammavalenani adhi sambhavimpakamundhe meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
ikanu meethoo vistharinchi maatalaadanu; ee lokaadhikaari vachuchunnaadu. Naathoo vaaniki sambandhamemiyuledu.
ayinanu nenu thandrini preminchuchunnaanani lokamu telisikonunatlu thandri naaku aagnaapinchinadhi neraverchutaku neneelaagu cheyuchunnaanu. Lendi, yikkadanundi velludamu.
nenu nijamaina draakshaavallini, naa thandri vyavasaayakudu.
naalo phalimpani prathi theegenu aayana theesi paaraveyunu; phalinchu prathi theege mari ekkuvagaa phalimpavalenani daaniloni panikiraani theegelanu theesi veyunu.
nenu meethoo cheppina maatanubatti meerippudu pavitrulai yunnaaru.
naayandu nilichiyundudi, meeyandu nenunu nilichiyundunu. theege draakshaavallilo nilichi yuntenegaani thananthata thaane yelaagu phalimpado, aalaage naayandu nilichiyuntene kaani meerunu phalimparu.
draakshaavallini nenu, theegelu meeru. Evadu naayandu nilichiyunduno nenu evaniyandu nilichi yunduno vaadu bahugaa phalinchunu; naaku verugaa undi meeremiyu cheyaleru.
evadainanu naayandu nilichiyundani yedala vaadu theegevale bayata paaraveya badi yendipovunu; manushyulu attivaatini poguchesi agnilo paara vethuru, avi kaalipovunu.
naayandu meerunu meeyandu naa maatalunu nilichiyundinayedala meekedi yishtamo adugudi, adhi meeku anugrahimpa badunu.
meeru bahugaa phalinchutavalana naa thandri mahimaparachabadunu; induvalana meeru naa shishyulaguduru.
thandri nannu elaagu premincheno nenunu mimmunu aalaagu preminchithini, naa premayandu nilichi yundudi.
